instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

end.text: Fronted adverbials are words or phrases that go at the beginning of a sentence. They describe the action in the sentence that follows.

atoms.a: Next year, I plan to travel the world!
atoms.b: ((Next year)), I plan to travel the world!

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: Once or twice a week, I go swimming.
atoms.b: ((Once or twice a week)), I go swimming.

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: In the distance, we could see the sea
atoms.b: ((In the distance)), we could see the sea.

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: Suddenly, my cat jumped down from the tree
atoms.b: ((Suddenly)), my cat jumped down from the tree.

instruction.text: Find the fronted adverbial in the sentence below.

atoms.a: Almost unbelievably, Marcus and his family made it to the airport on time
atoms.b: ((Almost unbelievably)), Marcus and his family made it to the airport on time.
